ns2:course.label: Physical Organic Chemistry
ns2:course.description: Advanced survey of physical organic chemistry. The emphasis is on structure and bonding in organic compounds; scope of reaction mechanisms, including reactive intermediates and how these mechanisms and intermediates are studied; and writing reasonable organic reaction mechanisms. Prerequisite: CHEM 332 or CHEM 436 and one year of physical chemistry.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: CHEM 332 or CHEM 436 and one year of physical chemistry.
